employers.name: Deloitte USI
employers.note: Automated 2026-09-14 with a new AvatureScraper class. deloiteus.avature.net/usijobs.deloitte.com is genuinely Avature (matches the earlier meta-tag verification), but has no job-search sitemap at all — the only enumeration surface is the paginated search-results HTML (?jobRecordsPerPage=10&jobOffset=N, 683 total listings). Detail pages carry JSON-LD but multi-location postings (the norm here) leave jobLocation empty; real per-city data lives in a separate '.article__header--locations' HTML block, parsed directly. Also fixed a real bug in BaseScraper's robots.txt parser while wiring this up: it treated '*' as a literal character instead of a wildcard, so this site's 'Allow: /*/careers' rule never matched and the catch-all 'Disallow: /' silently blocked every locale-prefixed careers path — a live end-to-end test (robots check + real scrape + parser.js filtering) confirmed the fix and 8/8 sample roles surviving filters, all real Bengaluru/Hyderabad postings.

meta.notes: Phase 2 (2026-09-13) and Phase 2b (2026-09-14) classification is based on live verification, not the source spec's assumptions — wrong often enough (Franklin Templeton, PwC AC, EY GDS, Marsh & McLennan being Phenom/SuccessFactors not Workday/Oracle; Standard Chartered's URL; KPMG's bucket; Bank of America/Barclays/Visa/AIG/CME Group being Workday despite being filed as custom; Bridgewater being Greenhouse; Charles Schwab moved to excluded/ entirely — robots.txt blocks everything, not just careers) that every employer was checked against its real, live site rather than trusted. 'oracle' means Oracle Fusion Recruiting Cloud specifically (no genuine legacy Taleo employer exists here). 'custom' covers Phenom, SAP SuccessFactors, and unidentified platforms via one CustomScraper (sitemap + schema.org JobPosting, JSON-LD or Microdata, with <title>-tag/URL-slug fallbacks for tenants whose Microdata is incomplete) — custom.render:true switches detail-page fetching to a headless browser for JS-shell tenants like Standard Chartered. 'greenhouse' is its own type since that vendor's public boards-api.greenhouse.io is a clean, well-documented API distinct from the sitemap convention. 12 employers remain active:false: 2 confirmed bot-protected (UBS, BNP Paribas, plus Blackstone — Cloudflare-challenged even via a real headless browser, per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12 a stop not a bypass), Deloitte USI (Avature, confirmed via robots.txt to have no job-listing sitemap at all — needs bespoke selector scraping), and 9 either genuinely proprietary platforms found even after Puppeteer rendering (Vanguard, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, Citadel) or still unidentified (KPMG, Zurich, ICE) — see each entry's 'note'.
